serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Dispenser is back and operating, but there’s a huge queue to the machine…
People are fighting over bread since some are hoarding large amounts of it and trying to resell…
Some break and pay the scalpers, even though this bread should be for free.
They are probably scared that the city will fall to chaos again.
There’s some commotion again…
Huh?! Dispenser ran out of bread! That never happened before!
I guess It’s time to go home, there’s nothing more to do here…
